label: Ubiquiti Mobile Router Industrial
description: DIN-rail industrial LTE router: 2x GbE RJ45, LTE Cat 4, Wi-Fi 4, one PoE input and one PoE output (10 W).
notes: Vendor figures from the Ubiquiti tech specs page: Networking Interface **(2) GbE RJ45 ports**, **LTE Cat 4** radio, **WiFi 4**, Nano SIM, PoE interface **(1) PoE input and (1) PoE output (max 10 W, requires a PoE+ switch)**, DIN-rail mounting. It is powered *and* powers something else over PoE: the 10 W output budget comes out of whatever the input supplies, and Cat 4 LTE is a floor of roughly 50 Mbit/s class here, well below what the gigabit ports suggest.
